item.title: Scratch My Ears
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: I hear the rustle of movement at the foot of the bed. I swing my legs over the side of the bed. As I do, the white ball of fur waits patiently. She can’t risk my big legs hitting her head As I swing sideways. There. Now I’m sitting up. She siddles close to me, head between my legs. Flopped ears awaiting their morning grace A kiss just above her eyes, between her ears.

item.title: The Gossamer Cloak
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: I beg you tp keep reading for just a minute. This coming week NASA plans to send three projects into space. One of them is the Carruthers Geocorona Observatory. This mission wants to better understand our outer atmosphere. This knowledge will help us understand changes that occur in the area just before we get to “outer space.” Scientists call this the geocorona. Scientists love big words. And, Of course, they need a very specific definition they all know and understand.
